_readme: Copy to pat_temp_sensors.json and replace the ROM ids with the ones printed by: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe .\pat_temp_logger.py --once . group = top / bottom (used for the top/bottom means and the temperature notes; other values are kept but not averaged). offset_C is added to the reading (from the side-by-side check of all sensors; 0 until measured).

28AA000000000001.name: top_ft232h
28AA000000000001.note: top controller board, green surface next to the FT232H (the non-contact thermometer spot)

28AA000000000002.name: top_array_centre
28AA000000000002.note: back of the top transducer array, centre

28AA000000000003.name: bottom_ft232h
28AA000000000003.note: bottom controller board, next to the FT232H

28AA000000000004.name: bottom_array_centre
28AA000000000004.note: back of the bottom transducer array, centre
